title: Cycle a seeded incident queue without immediate template repetition
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Use the existing deterministic shuffle/RNG to draw seeded permutations of the exact six catalog templates. On exhaustion, reshuffle with continued private server RNG and enforce that the immediately previous template cannot become the next draw. Define the deterministic correction and exact RNG advancement as a technical queue contract; it must not change any incident result after choices lock. Preserve immutable queue state and return next RNG explicitly. No client-controlled incident selection or fallback to random runtime calls.
acceptance: Each cycle visits I01–I06 once and the boundary between consecutive cycles never immediately repeats a template.
Same initial queue/RNG and action sequence reproduces exact incident order, correction and next RNG.
Empty/exhausted/corrupt queue states are validated without mutating prior state or creating an unbounded reshuffle loop.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
